title: 10 Moments That Reveal Whether a Godly Man Is the Real Thing
caption:
Anybody can look like a godly man in the pew on Sunday. The real test is smaller than that.

It's the tip after bad service. What he does with the cashier's extra change. How he drives when nobody he knows is watching. Who he is in the group chat versus who he is in the room where it counts.

Matthew 6:6 says the Father sees what's done in secret. That's the version of your faith He's actually grading.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #character #integrity
